interpretation: At strength 0.1 jspace: original answer fully erased (still_answer 0.000 vs 0.824 random), the swap_to concept itself becomes the argmax in 73% of items (concept substitution), and the full two-hop flip (answer about the swapped concept) completes in 12% of items. Random matched-norm controls leave the answer intact (82%) and rarely substitute (<=2% flip). Qualitatively consistent with the global-workspace picture: the mid-layer band (10-26) hosts a rewritable representation of the intermediate concept; the second hop re-reads it only partially at these strengths. Strength 0.4 collapses both jspace and random conditions (non-specific destruction).
